title: Provable Privacy Attacks on Trained Shallow Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2410.07632v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study what provable privacy attacks can be shown for trained 2-layer ReLU neural networks, focusing on two types of attacks: membership inference and data reconstruction. We prove that theoretical results on the implicit bias of 2-layer neural networks can be used to provably identify with high probability whether a given point was used in the training set in a high-dimensional, nearly orthogonal setting, and can also be used to construct a finite set of which at least a constant fraction are training points in a univariate setting. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to show provable vulnerabilities in this implicit-bias-driven setting.

translated_title: 可证明的隐私攻击：针对训练过的浅层神经网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2410.07632v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们研究了针对训练过的两层ReLU神经网络可展示的隐私攻击，重点关注两种攻击类型：成员推断和数据重建。我们证明，两层神经网络的隐式偏差理论结果可用于在高维、近似正交的设置中，以高概率可证明地识别给定点是否曾用于训练集，并且还可用于构建一个有限集合，其中至少一个常数比例的点在单变量设置中是训练点。据我们所知，我们的工作首次展示了在这种隐式偏差驱动设置中的可证明漏洞。
tldr: 本研究首次证明了在训练过的两层ReLU神经网络中，基于隐式偏差理论可实现可证明的成员推断和数据重建攻击。
en_tdlr: This work is the first to demonstrate provable membership inference and data reconstruction attacks on trained two-layer ReLU neural networks, leveraging implicit bias theory.
